title: Baba Farid Tailor premium multi-section site with catalog and measurement order form

requirements.summary: Create multi-section site structure with header navigation linking to Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, and Contact Us, including active section highlighting.
acceptanceCriteria: A header navigation is present on all pages/sections with links for Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, Contact Us.
Each nav item takes the user to the correct page/section.
The current page/section is visually highlighted in the navigation.

file_operations.description: Create the main app shell that renders the required sections (Home, About Us, Catalog, Order Now, Contact Us) with stable section anchors/IDs and provides the overall layout.

Implement a persistent header with nav links that scroll to the corresponding section and visually indicate the active section (e.g., via IntersectionObserver + state). Use shadcn-ui primitives (e.g., Button) for consistent interactions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small hook to track which section is currently in view and expose the active section key for navigation highlighting.
Ensure the app uses the created App component and preserves the existing React Query provider wiring needed for data fetching states.

requirements.summary: Add a premium top header area showing the business name prominently and a responsive, visually distinct logo placeholder region.
acceptanceCriteria: The header shows "Baba Farid Tailor" prominently.
A clearly marked logo placeholder area exists in the header (e.g., a framed box with 'Logo' label) and does not break layout on mobile.
Layout remains responsive across common breakpoints.

file_operations.description: Add the prominent brand name text and a dedicated logo placeholder block (visually distinct, responsive sizing, does not collapse the nav). Use shadcn-ui (e.g., Button) where appropriate for interactions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a reusable logo placeholder component (framed box with a 'Logo' label) designed to be swapped for an uploaded logo later.

requirements.summary: Show mobile number and email clearly in a top bar and/or footer using easily editable placeholder config.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile number and email are visible without needing to navigate away (in top bar and/or footer).
Values are implemented as easily editable placeholders (not hard-coded in multiple locations).
On mobile, the contact details remain readable and do not overlap other elements.

file_operations.description: Create a single source of truth for contact placeholders (mobile number + email) that can be replaced later without hunting through UI files.

Add a slim top bar that displays the configured mobile/email with responsive layout. Use shadcn-ui typography/utilities as composed components where helpful; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a footer that repeats the configured mobile/email (and optionally quick links) while staying readable on small screens.
Wire the TopContactBar and SiteFooter into the global layout so contact details are always visible without extra navigation.

requirements.summary: Build a premium Catalog section with category cards for Suits, Shirts, Pants, Traditional wear, allowing selection of a style to carry into the Order Now form.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog UI shows the four required categories: Suits, Shirts, Pants, Traditional wear.
Each category is displayed as a visually consistent card/tile with a title and brief placeholder description.
A user can select a category/style and proceed to (or prefill) the Order Now form with that selection.
Catalog data is sourced from the backend (not only hard-coded in the UI).

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook to fetch catalog data (categories/styles) via the existing backend capability and expose loading/error states.

Add a thin frontend client wrapper for calling backend capabilities (e.g., getCatalog) that centralizes integration details provided by core-infrastructure; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement the Catalog section UI: render four category tiles/cards and associated styles from fetched data; include selection UI that stores the chosen category/style for the Order Now section. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Button, Tabs/Badge) to achieve a premium card/tile layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add lightweight shared state (e.g., context or module store) to hold the currently selected category/style so Catalog selection can prefill Order Now.
Consume the shared selected category/style state to prefill the Order Now selection fields and keep the selection consistent when the user navigates from Catalog to Order Now.
Wire the CatalogSection into the site layout and ensure navigation scroll targets/IDs match the header links.

requirements.summary: Implement the Order Now section with catalog-based style selection, measurement inputs (at least Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder), size guidance UI, validation, and confirmation view after submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Order form allows selecting a category and style from the existing catalog list.
Measurements inputs include at least: Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder (and may include others like Sleeve, Neck, Hip, Inseam).
UI includes size chart guidance (e.g., a small table or expandable panel) and clearly states units (cm/in) with a single chosen unit or a unit selector.
Client-side validation prevents submission when required fields are missing or invalid (e.g., non-numeric measurements).
On submit, the order is stored in the backend and the user sees a confirmation state with an order reference (e.g., order ID).

file_operations.description: Create a React Query mutation hook for submitting an order via the backend capability, including exposing submitting/error/success states.

Build the Order Now section: category/style selectors populated from catalog data, measurement inputs (Length, Chest, Waist, Shoulder + additional common fields), basic contact info fields, unit handling guidance, client-side validation, and submission/confirmation UI showing returned order reference. Use shadcn-ui form primitives (e.g., Input, Label, Select, Button, Accordion, Table) for consistent premium UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a size guidance UI (table and/or expandable panel) stating measurement units and offering reference guidance without requiring authentication. Use shadcn-ui Accordion/Table for the expandable panel/table styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the OrderNowSection into the site layout and ensure the navigation scroll target/ID matches the header link.

requirements.summary: Add an About Us section with premium English copy highlighting bespoke tailoring expertise and craftsmanship.
acceptanceCriteria: About Us content includes a clear statement about bespoke tailoring expertise.
Copy is in English and matches a premium/professional tone.
Section layout is responsive and visually consistent with the site theme.

file_operations.description: Create a responsive About Us section with premium English copy explicitly mentioning bespoke tailoring expertise and premium craftsmanship.
Wire the AboutSection into the site layout and ensure the navigation scroll target/ID matches the header link.

requirements.summary: Create a Contact Us section with phone/email display, location placeholder text, and a validated contact form with submit/confirmation UX.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact section shows phone and email again for clarity.
Contact form includes fields: Name, Email or Phone, Message, with basic validation.
If backend storage is implemented: inquiries can be submitted, stored, and confirmed to the user; otherwise, the UI clearly indicates the form is not sending messages yet.

file_operations.description: Create a React Query mutation hook for contact inquiry submission via the backend capability, including loading/error/success states.

Implement Contact Us section: repeats configured phone/email, includes location placeholder text, and provides a form (Name, Email/Phone, Message) with basic validation and submit/confirmation states. Use shadcn-ui form primitives (e.g., Input, Textarea, Button, Alert) for consistent UX; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the ContactSection into the site layout and ensure the navigation scroll target/ID matches the header link.
Ensure ContactSection and footer/top bar reuse the same configured placeholders for phone/email to avoid duplicated hard-coded values.

requirements.summary: Apply a premium charcoal-grey base theme with gold accents and optional deep blue highlights, ensuring consistent typography, spacing, and states across the site.
acceptanceCriteria: The site consistently uses Charcoal Grey as a base with Gold accents; Deep Blue may be used sparingly for emphasis.
Typography, headings, and section spacing look consistent across pages/sections.
Buttons/links have clear hover/focus states and meet basic contrast/readability expectations.
No default blue+purple theme styling dominates the UI.

file_operations.description: Define global CSS variables and base styling to implement the charcoal base with gold accents (and optional deep blue highlight) and ensure consistent typography/spacing. Ensure styling avoids a default blue+purple look and supports clear hover/focus states.
Extend/align Tailwind theme tokens to support the charcoal/gold/deep-blue palette and consistent section spacing/typography utilities across the site.
Create a small layout wrapper for consistent section hierarchy (padding, max-width, heading spacing) applied across Home/About/Catalog/Order/Contact.
Adopt the shared Section wrapper and ensure consistent button/link styling usage across the required sections.

requirements.summary: Use React Query for catalog fetching and order/inquiry submissions with explicit loading, submitting, and error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog UI shows a loading state while fetching and a clear error state on failure.
Order submission shows a submitting state and a clear error state on failure.
Successful order submission resets the form or transitions to a confirmation state without requiring a page refresh.

file_operations.description: Ensure the catalog query is implemented with React Query and exposes loading/error states usable by the Catalog UI.
Ensure the order mutation exposes submitting/error/success states and returns the created order reference for confirmation rendering.
Ensure the inquiry mutation exposes submitting/error/success states and supports showing a clear confirmation or error message.
Add explicit React Query-driven loading and error UI states for catalog fetching. Use shadcn-ui Alert/Skeleton where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add submitting/disabled state handling, inline validation feedback, error messaging, and post-success confirmation transition/reset behavior using the React Query mutation state. Use shadcn-ui Alert/Skeleton where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add submitting state, success confirmation, and error display for inquiry submission using React Query mutation state. Use shadcn-ui Alert where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and render the required generated static images from frontend public assets to enhance the premium tailoring aesthetic.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed in frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Images are used in a way that improves the premium aesthetic (e.g., hero background/banner and/or subtle section background).
Images are responsive and do not cause layout shifts or readability issues.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static image asset: Premium fabric texture background, subtle weave pattern, dark charcoal tone, stored exactly at frontend/public/assets/generated/fabric-texture-bg.dim_1920x1080.png.

Add the generated static image asset: Elegant tailoring hero banner with abstract tailoring elements, charcoal and gold palette, stored exactly at frontend/public/assets/generated/tailoring-hero-banner.dim_2400x900.png.

Create a premium hero/banner section that references frontend/public/assets/generated/tailoring-hero-banner.dim_2400x900.png and overlays readable English copy and a primary call-to-action (e.g., scroll to Order Now).

Wire the HomeHeroSection into the Home area and apply the fabric texture background using frontend/public/assets/generated/fabric-texture-bg.dim_1920x1080.png in a way that remains responsive and avoids readability issues.
